unit_attributes.statement: This document is an invented public-display permit policy and a diagnostic document, not legal guidance.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All of the following conditions must be satisfied: (1) illuminate every public exit throughout the time the display remains open; (2) keep every public exit clear throughout that time; (3) appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout that time (unless an agency employee is assigned to supervise for that entire period); and (4) before admitting the first visitor, give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions: illuminate every public exit throughout the time the display remains open, keep every public exit clear throughout the time the display remains open, appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open (except when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period), and before admitting the first visitor, give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must illuminate every public exit throughout the time the display remains open.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must keep every public exit clear throughout the time the display remains open, with equipment stored behind a locked staff-only door not constituting an obstruction of a public exit.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For public exits of a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises.
unit_attributes.statement: Equipment stored behind a locked staff-only door is not an obstruction of a public exit.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, throughout the time the display remains open, except when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must appoint an adult steward who remains on site throughout the time the display remains open; this appointment duty does not apply when an agency employee is assigned to supervise the display for that entire period.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, before admitting the first visitor.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, for each inspection record given to the agency before admitting the first visitor.
unit_attributes.statement: For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, each inspection record must identify the display, the inspection date, and every public exit inspected.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When a storm warning is active, unless all of the following conditions are met: (1) the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof; (2) the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes; and (3) an agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All of the following conditions must be met: (1) the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof; (2) the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes; and (3) an agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
unit_attributes.statement: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met: the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof, the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes, and an agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When an agency officer authorizes an outdoor demonstration for the duration of an active storm warning.
unit_attributes.statement: An authorization granted by an agency officer for an outdoor demonstration during a storm warning expires when that warning ends, and it does not authorize demonstrations under a later warning.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For displays held entirely before sunset.
unit_attributes.statement: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For displays held entirely before sunset where the organizer is recommended to place a readable map near the entrance.
unit_attributes.statement: The recommendation to place a readable map near the entrance for displays held entirely before sunset does not create a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.
The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes, with weekends and holidays counting toward the 30 days.

unit_attributes.scope_text: After the display closes, if an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day retention period ends.
unit_attributes.statement: If an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day retention period ends after the display closes, the organizer must retain the inspection record until the agency closes the investigation.
Visitors are not required to supply their home addresses.
This policy does not prohibit visitors from bringing paper maps.
Other premises rules may restrict particular materials.
A queue may form when several groups arrive together.
